INSERT INTO checks (id, org_id, project_id, kind, name, token, schedule_kind,
                             cron_expr, tz, period_secs, grace_secs, max_runtime_secs)
         SELECT $1, $2, p.id, 'heartbeat', $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10
         FROM projects p
         WHERE p.org_id = $2
         ORDER BY p.created_at
         LIMIT 1
         RETURNING id
